guest.title: One week of food wey dem build for you.
guest.body: Tell us about your health and your pocket, and we go plan breakfast, lunch, dinner and small chops from food wey you don sabi, with shopping list wey match am.
points: Dem build am from your free health check

items.water: Keep bottle of water near you. Sometimes na thirst dey do you, you go think say na hunger.
items.plate: Fill half of your plate with vegetable, quarter with protein and quarter with starch.
items.cubes: Use one Maggi instead of two. Crayfish, onion and pepper go give am plenty taste.
items.batch: Cook beans or moi moi plenty one time and keep portions for fridge for up to 3 days.
items.swallow: Make your swallow reach the size of your fist and add one more spoon of vegetable soup.
items.fruit: Fresh fruit better pass juice: you go get the fibre and less sugar.
items.walk: Waka for 10 minutes after you chop, e dey help keep blood sugar steady.
